scope: Two known training windows; exploratory Q-Former only, not full-168 teacher or cross-video generalization
posterior_input: motion: cached causal real prefix; static: cached causal repeated-S0 prefix with same timestamps
causal_prefix_test: Perturb future raw state features and coordinates after horizons 3 and 7, recompute causal prefix memories and compare earlier Q outputs
joint_objective: motion/static branch average of RGB full+ROI+10/9 dynamic-weighted MAE plus 0.1 state loss and 0.1 teacher-code MSE; static target S0 at matching camera, weighting from paired codec difference only for loss
predeclared_numerical_checks: motion overall and h9 source motion MAE <=1.10 of paired free teacher; static weighted MAE <=1.10 of static free teacher; static and motion branch each closer to matching reference for at least 16 of 18 frames. Prefix causality, native GS replay and manual dynamic review separately required.
limitations: Free-code teacher is from two known windows and has yellow h3 color-proxy center error 10.81%; it is provisionally useful only for this diagnostic. No full-168 acceptance or generalization claim.
